'''''Ranunculus macrophyllus''''' is a species of flowering plant in the family [[Ranunculaceae]].<ref>{{Cite web|title=''Ranunculus macrophyllus'' Desf. - Encyclopedia of Life|url=https://eol.org/pages/5524480|access-date=2022-02-04|website=eol.org}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |last=Mifsud |first=Stephen |date=2002-08-23 |title=Ranunculus macrophyllus (Large-leaved Buttercup) : MaltaWildPlants.com - the online Flora of the Maltese Islands. |url=https://www.maltawildplants.com/RANU/Ranunculus_macrophyllus.php |access-date=2022-03-07 |website=www.maltawildplants.com |language=en-us}}</ref> It is a [[perennial plant|perennial]] native to southwestern Europe (Portugal, Spain, the [[Balearic Islands]], Corsica, and Sardinia) and North Africa (Morocco, Algeria, Tunisia, and Libya).<ref name = powo/>

Two subspecies are accepted.<ref name = powo/>
*''Ranunculus macrophyllus'' subsp. ''barceloi'' {{small|(Grau) Romo}} – Balearic Islands ([[Mallorca]])
*''Ranunculus macrophyllus'' subsp. ''macrophyllus'' – entire range
